metadata.title: SYNTHETIC Mera Khet proof-of-concept -- field boundaries are fabricated, placed inside a real village
metadata.synthetic_data_notice: SYNTHETIC: the field polygons and farmer labels on this page are fabricated for demonstration only -- no real farmer drew these. REAL: every NDVI, cropland-fraction and field-wetness number is a live satellite query via the same Mera Khet Worker a real farmer's drawn field would hit. District-level climate/soil figures are the same real files the live dashboard uses.
metadata.boundary_source: Survey of India village boundary via NWDP (vil_lgd 476504, Simrol, Mhow block, Indore district) -- same file as crop_insurance_pilot's pilot

future_2040.superseded_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-02. Computed by scripts/05b_run_cmip6_2040.py over a 5 km buffer around this district's centroid POINT. The authoritative CMIP6 2040 projection for this district is now dashboard/data/cmip6_2040/<state>/<district>.json (scripts/09_gee_national_cmip6_2040.py), which reduces over the district's real Survey of India POLYGON - the same spatial unit every other district-level layer in this portal uses, and the same unit used for all 733 districts. Identical 8-model NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 ensemble, scenario and windows; only the spatial unit differs, and the two agree closely (hot days within 0.5-3.6 d/yr, peak Tmax within 0.3 degC). Retained here for provenance, no longer rendered anywhere. Two further caveats apply to the values in this block: 'heatwave_days_per_yr' is a count of days with Tmax >= 40 degC (a HOT-DAY count), NOT the IMD heatwave-event index used by this file's own observed 'indices' block; and 'max_summer_tmax' / 'rx1day_mm' here are single window maxima, so their deltas carry the window-length bias described in docs/METHODOLOGY.md section 5.

zameen_ka_hisab.cropland_fraction_source: live Dynamic World V1 classification via Mera Khet Worker /analyze

fasal_ki_sehat.source: Google Earth Engine, live per-field query: Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized NDVI (10 m, most recent cloud-free scene, 2026-04-21 to 2026-10-21) + Dynamic World V1 cropland classification (10 m, mode composite, 2025-03-21 to 2026-10-21) + Sentinel-1 GRD VV/VH backscatter (10 m, most recent scene, 2026-08-22 to 2026-10-21, field vs. containing district via FAO/GAUL/2015/level2)
fasal_ki_sehat.note: Single live satellite reading at generation time -- this proof-of-concept does not compute a 6-month history (that needs repeated live GEE calls per field, out of scope for a demo of this size).

khet_wetness.caveat: NOT a m3/m3 soil-moisture measurement. Sentinel-1 radar backscatter (VV, dB) compared against the SAME satellite pass over the field's containing district -- a real relative comparison (calibration/speckle mostly cancel in the ratio), but backscatter also responds to vegetation and surface roughness, not moisture alone, so it cannot be inverted to an absolute moisture value.
